about: SYNTHETIC audit notes, written in auditor shorthand for this demo. No real company, system, person or incident.

notes.text:
CRM, customer master data. Sample n=40 churned customers
- RetSched v2: delete 24 mo after contract end
- 31/40 > 5 yrs old, full contact history still there
- no automated purge, IT: manual cleanup 'planned'

WH video analytics (go-live 03/2026)
- cams measure picking speed per employee, shift leads see dashboards
- face blur OFF by default
- no DPIA on file, DPO not involved pre go-live

Payroll outsourced (ext. provider, since 2019)
- employee bank details + salary data
- only 2019 MSA on file, no Art. 28 clauses, no signed DPA
- procurement: 'DPA in progress' (8 months)

HR system incl. sick-leave data
- no audit trail for admin actions since migration (01/2026)
- 3 shared admin accts (hradmin1-3), no MFA
- last access recert. Q2/2025

INC-0412, misdirected mail
- 14.05.: invoices for 212 customers (name, address, amount) sent to wrong distribution list
- detected same day (service desk)
- SA notified 22.05., no reason for delay on file
- entry in breach register: yes

RoPA
- 37 activities, last review 06/2026
- retention period missing for 2 (newsletter, applicant pool)
- owner for update already assigned

Ticketing SaaS (support)
- customer names, emails, order history, hosting US
- vendor file: no SCCs, no TIA
- vendor not on EU-US DPF list (checked 09/2026)

Newsletter (~18k subscribers)
- unsubscribe = login + 3 steps
- consent proof only as monthly aggregate counts, no per-subscriber timestamp/source
- DOI active

DSAR log 2026 (privacy team)
- 11 received, 3 answered after 6-9 wks
- no extension notice to requesters
- no deadline tracking in tool

Erasure requests (CRM + marketing DWH)
- CRM deletion done within ~1 week
- same customers still in marketing DWH + nightly backups restored to test env
- no suppression list against re-import
